inputTaskId.description: A prior Meshy task id to retexture (fast path). One of inputTaskId / modelUrl / sourceAssetPath is required.

modelUrl.description: A publicly fetchable model URL (.glb/.gltf/.obj/.fbx/.stl) to retexture.

sourceAssetPath.description: A stored asset (game-relative assetPath) to retexture. Requires COS so the model can be shared as a public URL.

textStylePrompt.description: Text describing the desired texture style. One of textStylePrompt / imageStyleUrl is required.

imageStyleUrl.description: A 2D style image URL guiding the texture (takes priority over textStylePrompt).

aiModel.description: Meshy retexture model. Defaults server-side to latest.
